body:
InfoHub can collect and display information, but its AI outputs were not versioned and the larger system had no stable way to consume items, stories, or topics. This change turns the existing site into a reusable NLP information module without changing the current pages.

The database now records ordered migrations and stores successful curation inputs and outputs with the model and pipeline version. A read-only `/api/v1` surface provides cursor-paginated items, item evidence and analyses, persistent stories, and topics. The health response includes schema and NLP archive status, and the new design document defines how event-level sentiment and macro analysis will build on this layer.

Validation:
- 46 offline regression tests pass
- Python compilation passes
- production-sized database copy migrates idempotently in 0.17s
- SQLite integrity check passes and foreign-key check returns no violations
- `/api/v1/items`, `/stories`, `/topics`, and `/api/health` return 200 on the migrated copy
title: Add versioned NLP integration foundation
